what: Partition self-heal must not treat the already-fixed cleanup selector as unfixed
scenario_or_breakage: Naive matching on `-k cleanup` also matches Makefile:788 `-k 'cleanup and not cleanup_target_ok'`, so a stale overlap log could rewrite an already-correct recipe and break strict partition or pytest selection
suggested_fix: Parse only the `test-implement-cleanup-script` recipe; treat unfixed only when `-k` expression is exactly `cleanup` (no `not cleanup_target_ok`); no-op otherwise
